hypothesis: Training a learned 16-dimensional latent representation of 16-bit public entity IDs from identity-pair contrastive positives and hard Hamming negatives—not graph-specific QA—improves frozen recurrent composition transfer to novel fork/cycle graph topology families without coded endpoint equality.

design.learning: 256 pair examples per step, 135 deterministic Adam steps; 16x16 projection plus bias (257 parameters), 50/50 positive identical vs one/two-bit-flip negative; no graph-question training labels; no validation-pair access during training
design.note: Graph training families registered but unused by identity-only learner; validation topologies and source are author-created new development, never independently authenticated F3 heldout
design.model_frozen_composition_source: W-F5 original 38642413429, five trained recurrent parameters
controls: same learned new projection + coded OR traversal
frozen F5 learned matcher + learned recurrent composition

limits: Engineered raw 16-bit features and fixed composition schedule remain; 257 learned external weights; no coded entity equality in candidate forward inference. No F3 first-use or independent source-birth witness.
